components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). Optional;
            when present it is combined with the last name to form the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On the response this is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized on create
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized the same way as 'addressLine1' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized into
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The
            result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned, and duplicate telephones are detected by comparing it.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the 'ageBand' (computed against the
            registrationDate).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region per the
            fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with
            no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when
            given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, permits registering this owner even though another
            owner already belongs to the same household (same last name and
            postcode); it is then recorded as a declared household member and is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The flag only bypasses the household
            duplicate block; the householdId itself is always derived from the last
            name and postcode. Optional; defaults to false. This flag is only a
            create-time hint and is not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                using the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title and last
                name joined by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name
                when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived at read time from the stored E.164
                'telephone', which itself stays in raw E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity representation. Always 2: the
                memberId, identityKey and householdId are grouped under the nested
                'identity' object and every identifier is derived by the version-2
                algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the calendar year in which the fiscal year containing the
                (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate began. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July, so a registration in July-December belongs to a fiscal year
                labelled with its own year and one in January-June with the previous year.
              type: string
              pattern: '^FY[0-9]{2}$'
              example: FY26
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived at create time. Points start at 0 and
                accumulate: 2 when an email is present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when the owner's tenure — the number of elapsed fiscal years
                (the fiscal year starting on 1 July) — exceeds one.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3 points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and
                level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION segment of the memberId (its leading
                region prefix), i.e. the region derived from the postcode, or 'UNKNOWN'
                when no member id is assigned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's timezone as an IANA name, derived from the locality (region)
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when the locality
                is not one of those regions.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first
                name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (i.e.
                already carry the current business day as their registrationDate),
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already contains between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive), i.e. it is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created while
                sharing an existing owner's last-name Soundex and postcode while its whole
                identity key differed (for example a different telephone); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of
                (same last-name Soundex and postcode, different identity key). Absent when
                possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants manual review because any of the
                following hold: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is
                true); its email domain is disposable-adjacent (not exactly on the
                disposable blocklist, but a subdomain of a blocklisted domain or
                sharing a blocklisted provider's second-level name under a different
                top-level domain, e.g. 'mailinator.net' or 'sub.tempmail.com'); or
                its city is over its soft capacity (holds 40 or more owners, the
                same soft limit that raises capacityWarning). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. False for a newly created owner;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (setting this true) while
                retaining the record, and the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks
                ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from birthDate against
                the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the three derived identifiers (memberId,
        identityKey and householdId), each rederived under the version-2 algorithm
        that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag so no value collides with a version-1
        one.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>':
            the version-2 region code (the postcode/city region with the fixed 'V2'
            version tag mixed in, for example 'NSWV2'), the 2-digit fiscal year of
            the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on
            1 July), the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
            normalized telephone concatenated with the last name (HASH8), and a
            single Luhn check digit (CHK) computed over the digits of
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned on create.
          type: string
          example: NSWV2261A2B3C4D5
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's identity key, the single derived value all duplicate
            detection is based on: the full lower-case hex SHA-256 digest over
            'identityRegion|normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where
            the identityRegion is the version-2 region code carrying the fixed 'V2'
            version tag, the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is its
            lower-cased value (empty when absent) and the last-name segment is the
            American Soundex code of the last name. A create is rejected with 409
            only when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
          example: '3b8c1a2d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A deterministic identifier shared by all owners in the same household:
            the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the version-2
            region code, the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the
            same region, last name and postcode receive the same value automatically.
            Always assigned on create.
          type: string
          example: A1B2C3D4E5F6
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.

        lastName:

            - MRS
            - MS

          example: DR

          title: Address
          description: >-

            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On the response this is the composed, normalized address:
            the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized

          maxLength: 255

          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized on create
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized the same way as 'addressLine1' when present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized into
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The
            result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned, and duplicate telephones are detected by comparing it.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'

          title: Email address

            postcode); it is then recorded as a declared household member and is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate. The flag only bypasses the household
            duplicate block; the householdId itself is always derived from the last
            name and postcode. Optional; defaults to false. This flag is only a

          default: false

              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true

              title: Owner segment

                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:

                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created while

+            the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the version-2

lines: +     * The fixed version tag mixed into the region code that feeds every version-2 identifier
+     * so that no value produced under version 1 is ever produced again. It appears only INSIDE
+     * the identifiers, never in the user-facing {@link #getLocality() locality},
+     * {@link #getTimezone() timezone} or the {@link #getOwnerSegment() owner segment}'s region.
+     * The version-2 region code used INSIDE the identifiers: the plain {@link #getRegion() region}
+     * with the fixed {@link #IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG 'V2'} version tag mixed in (e.g. {@code NSW ->
+     * NSWV2}). Because the tag is not a hex digit and the plain region never contains it, mixing it
+     * in guarantees every identifier changes and no version-1 value is reproduced. This tagged code —
+     * not the plain region — is what gets embedded in the memberId, hashed into the identity key and
* The owner's locality: the {@code REGION} segment of its {@link #memberId} (its leading region

* Renders the immutable structured {@code OWNER_CREATED} audit event as a compact JSON object at
     * schema version 2:
     * {@code {schemaVersion:2, seq, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel, ownerSegment,
     * event:'OWNER_CREATED'}}. The {@code memberId} field carries the owner's current
     * {@link #primaryIdentifier(Owner) primary identifier} (the version-2 member id) and
     * {@code ownerSegment} is the owner segment recomputed from that version-2 identity. All values
     * are numeric or a code drawn from {@code [A-Z0-9-_]}, so no JSON escaping is required.
     *
     * @param seq   the monotonically increasing event sequence for this create
     * @param owner the owner just created
     * @return the event serialized as a JSON string
     */
    private static String ownerCreatedEvent(long seq, Owner owner) {
        return String.format(
            "{\"schemaVersion\":2,\"seq\":%d,\"ownerId\":%d,\"memberId\":\"%s\",\"membershipLevel\":%d,"
                + "\"ownerSegment\":\"%s\",\"event\":\"OWNER_CREATED\"}",
            seq, owner.getId(), primaryIdentifier(owner), owner.getMembershipLevel(), owner.getOwnerSegment());
    }

## What changed

**Version-2 region code (the mixing point)** — `Owner.java`
- Added `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"` and `getIdentityRegion()`, which returns the plain region with the `V2` tag mixed in (e.g. `NSW → NSWV2`). Because `V2` is never a hex digit and the plain region never contains it, every identifier that embeds this code changes and can never reproduce a version-1 value.

**The three identifiers now derive from the V2 region**
- `memberId` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.memberIdFor`): region segment is now `getIdentityRegion()` → `NSW2616E6609E3` became `NSWV22616E6609E9` (Luhn check digit recomputed too).
- `identityKey` (`Owner.getIdentityKey`): SHA-256 input now prefixed with `identityRegion|…`.
- `householdId` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.householdIdFor`): SHA-256 input now prefixed with the identity region.

**User-facing region fields stay plain (no V2 tag)** — `Owner.java`
- `getLocality()` no longer reads the region back off the memberId (which now carries `V2`); it returns the plain `getRegion()` (`NSW`). `timezone` and `ownerSegment`'s area derive from that, so they stay correct — this is the owner-segment recompute the spec called for.

**Response shape** — `openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper.java`
- Added a new `OwnerIdentity` schema; moved `memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId` off the top level into a nested `identity` object.
- Added top-level integer `apiVersion` = 2. The mapper populates both via `toOwnerIdentity(...)` and an `apiVersion` expression.

**Audit schema v2** — `OwnerRestControllerV1.ownerCreatedEvent`
- The structured `OWNER_CREATED` event now includes `"schemaVersion":2` and `"ownerSegment"` recomputed from the version-2 identity.

Request fields are unchanged. The provided `AcceptanceTest` (apiVersion=2, identity grouping, no top-level identifiers) passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
